# Bug Report Template

A standard GitHub issue template designed to help users report bugs or unexpected behavior cleanly and effectively.

## Template Content

```markdown

name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or unexpected behavior
title: "[Bug]: "
labels: bug
---
```
